knownGaps.criterion: close and the supervisor never both act on the same order: close reads the ledger fresh and validates the order's current phase before appending.
knownGaps.reason: This is architectural, not a new mechanism: runFactoryClose calls openLedger() fresh then immediately validates and appends within one synchronous call, the same one-shot pattern RequestStop/RequestResume/RequestRerun already use, none of which carry a dedicated race-simulation test either. closeable()'s phase check (exercised by TestCloseableRefusesEveryOtherPhase and the ledger-unchanged assertion in TestCloseRefusesAnOrderThatIsNotParkedOrStopped) is the only testable surface; a true concurrent-process race isn't exercisable from a single-process unit test.

knownGaps.criterion: close refuses when --shipped-by is missing, with exit code 1 before taking any action, naming --shipped-by as required.
knownGaps.reason: Enforced by cobra's MarkFlagRequired, which only fires through Command.Execute() (verified via the new binary-level test TestFactoryCloseRequiresTheShippedByFlag in cmd/loom/cmd/factory_test.go). At the application layer, an empty --shipped-by also fails isHTTPURL('') (covered by TestIsHTTPURL and TestCloseableRefusesAnInvalidURL), giving the same refusal redundantly, consistent with how run --spec and state --stage/--gate's own required flags are (not separately) tested elsewhere in this codebase.
